description: This is the main FastAPI application file for the Nutrition Tracker backend, defining API routes, middleware, and integrating various modules such as models, authentication, food management, and nutrition calculations.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: A simple endpoint for health checking the API's responsiveness.

methods.name: register_user(data: UserRegister)
methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user.

methods.name: login_user(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends())
methods.description: Endpoint to authenticate a user and provide a JWT token.

methods.name: add_food_entry( entry: FoodEntryCreate, user: dict = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Creates a new food log entry for the current user.

methods.name: list_food( date_filter: Optional[date] = Query(None, description="(Optional) Date to filter entries"), user: dict = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Lists food entries for the user, optionally filtered by date.

methods.name: get_food( entry_id: int = Path(..., ge=1), user: dict = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Fetches a specific food entry by ID.

methods.name: update_food( entry_id: int = Path(..., ge=1), entry: FoodEntryUpdate = ..., user: dict = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Updates an existing food entry by ID.

methods.name: delete_food( entry_id: int = Path(..., ge=1), user: dict = Depends(get_current_user) )
dashboard( for_date: Optional[date] = Query(None, description="Date for the dashboard (defaults to today)"), user: dict = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Provides a nutritional summary for the user for a given day.

methods.name: nutrition_history( user: dict = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Returns user's nutrition statistics/history for visual analytics.

methods.name: fetch_macros( for_date: Optional[date] = Query(None, description="Date to fetch calories/macros for (defaults to today)"), user: dict = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Fetches and calculates total macros and calories for a specific date.
